d.t: A HYBRID LIGHT WEIGHT POLYMER FORTIFIED TILE ADHESIVE
d.s: SikaTile-305 Master Lite is a hybrid light weight polymer fortified tile adheisve suitable for internal and external applications including residential pools and spas on both wall and floor substrates.
a: White colour - colour may vary dependant on local sand source.
us: SikaTile-305 Master Lite can be used as a thin-bed tile adhesive for the following applications,
Suitable Sika waterproofing membranes designed to receive direct fixed tile
Existing Ceramic tiles (primed with Sikafloor-14 Prep N Prime Impact)
other suitable construction boards designed to receive tiles*
* refer to board manufacturers strict instructions for further details and load limits
Stone not sensitive to moisture and dimensionally stable

sec.t: If unopened 12 months from date of manufacture.
Store in dry cool conditions, off ground out of direct sunlight. High humidity will reduce shelf life.
5.5 - 6 Litres of clean cool potable water per 15kg bag
2 hours at 23° degrees and 50% relative humidity. Adhesive may need restirring during its pot life. Restir without adding any additional water.
30 minutes at 23°C degrees and 50% relative humidity

Application | Wait Time Grouting and light foot traffic | 24 Hours Wet Area Service | 5 Days Submerged Applications ie pools | 21 Days * Wait times are tested at 23°C and 50% relative humidity and should be used as a guide only. Hot climates reduce wait times, and cool or cold climates will extend wait times.
7.5m2 with a 10mm notched trowel Coverage is dependant of surface profile and application technique.
Personal protective equipment Mixing drill with stirrer attachment Clean mixing buckets Trowels

All surfaces must be installed according to manufacturer’s instructions and or relevant Australian Standard(s) and be structurally sound, dry, clean and free from movement, oil, grease, wax, sealers, curing compounds, release agents and any other loose or contaminating material. Thoroughly clean old surfaces, or new surfaces that have been treated, prior to tiling. Deeply contaminated surfaces must be prepared/abraded to a clean, sound surface. Expose at least 80% of the original substrate of painted surfaces. Substrates shall meet relevant deflection standards outlined in the relevant Australian Standards (AS3958). CONCRETE SUBSTRATES: New concrete shall be 14 days old and be left with a wood float finish. Steel trowel finished concrete is generally acceptable if the concrete allows water penetration. Concrete above 35MPa shall be mechanically prepared. CEMENT BOARD AND SHEETING: All boards and sheets must be fixed in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions and specifically designed for tiling. SCREEDS & MORTAR BEDS: Sand cement screeds must be installed as per relevant Australian Standards and left for a minimum 24 hours prior to tiling. Screeds may need longer drying time in cold climates. TILE ON TILE APPLICATIONS: Ensure all existing tiles are firmly fixed, loose or hollow tiles must be removed and the area repaired using a suitable Sika repair mortar. Existing tiles shall be adequately cleaned prior to the application of the primer. Existing tiles shall be primed with Sikafloor-14 Prep N Prime Impact and allowed to dry prior to tiling.

All surfaces except waterproofing membranes shall be primed prior to application. Priming Guide: Application | Primer Porous & Dense substrates | SikaTile 010 Secure prime Non-porous substrates and Tile on tile | Sikafloor-14 Prep n Prime Impact Refer to the relevant product data sheet for the primer for additional information.

Measure recommended amount of clean cool potable water and slowing add the SikaTile-305 Master Lite powder. Gradually stir the mixture untill it reaches a smooth lump free consistency (approximately 2 minutes). Allow the mixture to stand or "slake" for 3-5 minutes then restir for an additional minute without add any aditional water. Restiring during the adhesives pot life may be required, do not add any additional water, restir only.

Tiles shall be fixed in accordance with Australian Standards. Ensure the back of tiles are from dust and contaminates. Apply the adhesive with a notched trowel to the substrate to achieve minimum coverage requirement outlined in the relevant Australian Standards. Adhesive notches should be applied in a single direction. Apply tiles into the wet adhesive and break the adhesive notches to fully bed the tile in the adhesive layer. Ensure adequate coverage outlined in the Australlian Standards is achieved to both substrate and the back of tiles. Tiles 400x400 and larger shall be back buttered as per relevant Australian Standards. Clean excess adhesive out of the grout joints while the adhesive is still wet. Allow the adhesive to dry and set prior to grouting.
Tools and equipment can be cleaned with water prior to the adhesive setting. Adhesive that has set will require mechanical removal.

storage.label: Conditions for safe storage
storage.text: Store in original container. Keep in a well-ventilated place. Observe label precautions. Store in accordance with local regulations.

storage.label: Further information on storage stability
storage.text: Keep in a dry place. No decomposition if stored and applied as directed.

handling.label: Advice on protection against fire and explosion
handling.text: Avoid dust formation. Provide appropriate exhaust ventilation at places where dust is formed.

handling.label: Advice on safe handling
handling.text: Avoid formation of respirable particles. Avoid exceeding the given occupational exposure limits (see section 8). Do not get in eyes, on skin, or on clothing. For personal protection see section 8. Persons with a history of skin sensitisation problems or asthma, allergies, chronic or recurrent respiratory disease should not be employed in any process in which this mixture is being used. Smoking, eating and drinking should be prohibited in the application area. Follow standard hygiene measures when handling chemical products

handling.label: Hygiene measures
handling.text: Handle in accordance with good industrial hygiene and safety practice. When using do not eat or drink. When using do not smoke. Wash hands before breaks and at the end of workday.

respiratory.label: Respiratory protection
respiratory.text: In case of inadequate ventilation wear respiratory protection. Respirator selection must be based on known or anticipated exposure levels, the hazards of the product and the safe working limits of the selected respirator. particulate filter P

hands.label: Hand protection
hands.text: Chemical-resistant, impervious gloves complying with an approved standard should be worn at all times when handling chemical products if a risk assessment indicates this is necessary. Follow AS/NZS 1337.1 Recommended: Butyl rubber, PVC, cotton gloves

skin_body.label: Skin and body protection
skin_body.text: Protective clothing (e.g. safety shoes, long-sleeved working clothing, long trousers) Follow AS 2210:3

engineering_controls.label: Appropriate engineering controls
engineering_controls.text: Avoid dust formation. Provide appropriate exhaust ventilation at places where dust is formed.
